For those who don't know, scraped content is when a website's only functionality is to trawl the web, or even a particular site, grab all the text and images from a popular page, and rehost it as its own content, removing things like logos, all automatically (note that this is different than archiving. Archives make the source of their pages clear, whereas scraped sites pretend to be that source, and perhaps have a tiny link at the bottom to take you to the original so that they can claim to google that they simply serve to promote the original, as scraped sites are likely to get delisted otherwise). Such sites are not moral, as they generate ad revenue from content that they do not own, and are not in any way modifying, and are generally parasitic to the internet as a whole; most are just after a quick buck from ad revenue. There's no reason why we should allow them, and link them over the original source they scraped from.
